title: Ali ke Samne
body:
Muskura Kar Bole Paighmbar.. Ali Ke Samne (X2)
Kuch Nahi Hai Zulm Ka Lashkar ... Ali Ke Samne
Zulfiqar e Haidari (As) Se Kis Tarha Bach Payenge
Wo Yaqeenan Maut Se Jaldi Gale Mil Jayenge
Aake Dekhen Marhab o Antar ... Ali Ke Samne
Hai Dua Tujhse Yehi Meri Khudaye Mustafa (Saww)
Jald Jannat Ki Taraf Jaye Gada'ye Fatema (Sa)
Tu Bulana Yeh Mujhe Keh Kar ... Ali Ke Samne
Muskura Kar Hazrat e Salman Kehte They Sada
Shukre Haq Hai Dil Me Rehte Hen Faqat Mushkil Kusha
Fakhr Se Jhukta Hai Mera Sar ... Ali Ke Samne
Hogi Tayyari Jo Jashn e Haidar e Karrar Ki
Bil Yaqee'n Hogi Nizamat Misame Tammar Ki
Jab Sajega Hashr Me Mimber ... Ali Ke Samne
Jis Tarha Rehte Hen Naukr Char Su Arbab Ke
Jaise Hote Hen Sitare Sath Me Mehtab Ke
Aise Hen Salman Or Buzar ... Ali Ke Samne
Aashiqaan e Murtaza (As) Se Bughz Mat Rakhna Zara
Ae Muqassir Hashr Me Payege Forun He Saza
Dekhna Ghaali Unhe Keh Kar ... Ali Ke Samne
Jab Unhe Khud Khaliq e Konain Ne Bakhsha Laqab
Rubaru Shere Khuda Ke Koi Ruk Sakta Hai Kab
Kuch Nahi Hen Khandaq o Khaibar ... Ali Ke Samne
Rubaru Payege Jis Dam Haidar e Karrar Ko
Padh Ke 'MEHDI' Wajd Me 'ABBAS' Ke Ashaar Ko
Lutf Lega Qabr Ke Andr ... Ali Ke Samne
